_note: Demo fixture. This toy pull request exists only in the local sandbox remote, so its review cannot be fetched from GitHub. Same shape as GitHub's REST API (pulls/{n} and pulls/{n}/comments).

reviews.body: Thanks for the PR! A few things before we can merge.

comments.body: Please don't do money math in floats. Use `decimal.Decimal` and quantize every share to 2 places (`ROUND_HALF_UP`).
Silently returning `[]` hides bugs. Raise a `ValueError` when `people` is not a positive integer, and also when `tip_pct` is negative.
Please add a test that the shares always add up exactly to the total including tip, e.g. 100 split 3 ways. Any leftover cent should go to the first person(s).
